paragraphs: Ranger Mark's Story, posted by May. Each Explorer writes about one person for our club project. I chose Ranger Mark, because I like his job. He is the ranger of our nature park, and he always has time for questions. On Saturday, I asked him many questions at the park gate. Here is his life in short.

Mark was born in May in a small village near a river. As a boy, he wanted to be an astronaut. He looked at the stars every night. His mother gave him a book about space. He read it again and again. At ten, he slept in a tent in the garden to see the stars better. However, he also loved the outdoors. Every morning, he ran up the hill near his house.

At fifteen, he went to a school in the town. He studied science, and he played football after school. He liked English, too, and he read many books. At eighteen, he got his first job. He was a receptionist at a campsite by a lake. He gave the guests keys and maps, and he answered the phone. Sometimes the guests asked him hard questions. However, he did not like to sit inside all day. He often walked around the campsite and talked to the guests.

At twenty, Mark decided to go to college. He studied nature for two years. He learned the names of many birds and trees. Then he worked as a helper in a nature park. He carried water, cleaned the paths, and helped the visitors. At twenty-five, he finally became a ranger. That was the start of his career. He has been a ranger for fifteen years.

Today, Mark lives near the park, and he still looks at the stars at night. "I did not become an astronaut," he said to me. "But I explore the park every day, and I love my job." I think that he is a happy man. The park is the right place for a man who loves stars and trees. Which job do you want to do? Tell us in a message!
